data.long_meaning: The name Sharvilraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' which means 'Lord Shiva', and 'Raj' which means 'King'. It is a beautiful and powerful name that signifies the presence of the Lord of Gods within an individual. It is a name that inspires strength, wisdom, and power. The name Sharvilraj carries the meaning “King of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvilraj usually hope their child will grow to embody king of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is deeply spiritual and is associated with the divine presence of Lord Shiva. It is a name that is believed to bring blessings of strength, wisdom, and power from the Lord.
data.etymology: Sharvilraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Gods.”

historical_references.reference: Sharvilraj was a prominent Jaina monk and scholar during the Gupta Empire (ca. 320-550 CE). He is known for his works on Jaina philosophy, particularly his commentary on the Tattvartha Sutra.

Sharvilraj is also mentioned in the 14th century Jaina text, the Harivamsa, as a disciple of the Jaina sage, Nathmaliswara. In the text, Sharvilraj is depicted as having a profound understanding of Jaina scriptures and is considered an authority on Jaina philosophy.
